frequency_question: What proportion of major federal agency rules complete the full procedural lifecycle from proposal to final publication within 294 days?
membership_rule: Includes all economically significant rules proposed by federal agencies that reached final publication; excludes rules abandoned, withdrawn, or pending past the allotted window.
provenance_note: 6 cases named, 10 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.7x)
coverage_note: 6 named; estimated roughly 10 major contested rules meeting timeline constraints in recent cohorts.
known_gaps: Excludes minor non-significant rules which have much faster turnaround times.
skeleton: Not applicable; enumerating historical major rulemakings directly.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 10 major contested rulemakings sampled across recent administrations.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and OIRA review structures remain stable across this horizon.
